$comment: Provenance for the VENDORED recognition engine. recognitionEngine.mjs is a byte-for-byte mirror of the upstream file below — never edit it in this repo. To re-vendor: copy the upstream file over it, then update `upstream.commit`, `upstream.committedAt` and `sha256` here. tests/recognitionEngineParity.test.mjs fails if the local copy stops matching this hash.

upstream.note: Named .tsx upstream for the in-browser Babel loader, but it is plain ES with no TypeScript or JSX syntax — an invariant enforced by that repo's own tests. That is what lets this repo load it as a native ES module with no build step.
